other_conditions: At least 20 years of experience in journalism
Accredited with the Information, Public Relations & Languages Department, Haryana for at least the last five years
Must open an Aadhaar‑linked savings bank account in any nationalised bank
No criminal proceedings pending against the applicant
Must submit a live certificate every January
Pension will be discontinued if a criminal case is registered or if conduct is found against journalism ethics
If receiving a pension of less than ₹10,000 per month from another State Government, the pension under this scheme will be reduced by that amount
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹10,000 is provided to eligible accredited media persons, with continuation to the spouse after death if no other regular income is received.
